brand.name: AmanicX
brand.description: AmanicX creates privacy-first AI studios, intelligent local desktop assistants, and custom Linux distributions engineered with intention.

projects.name: Eva
projects.tagline: Characters with a world of their own
projects.short_description: A privacy-first, multi-theme, memory-aware AI character and world conversation studio for Desktop, Android, and Web.
projects.full_description: Eva is an advanced client studio for chatting with and designing multi-dimensional AI characters. Unlike typical single-prompt web interfaces, Eva gives you a complete creative canvas: design deep personas across 14 distinct psychological fields with independent section regeneration, drop them into evolving worlds with dynamic reputation and lore tracking, and connect to any model (Groq, OpenRouter, OpenAI, or offline Ollama/LM Studio) with 100% local privacy and zero telemetry.
highlights: Three tailored visual studios: Companion Chatbot, Anime Roleplay, and World Simulator
14-field Persona Generator with section-by-section independent regeneration
Universal BYOK: Groq, OpenRouter, OpenAI, and fully offline Ollama/LM Studio
Edge-to-edge Android 16 APK + Windows, Linux, and Apple Silicon builds

key_features.title: Three Distinct Studios
key_features.description: Minimalist companion assistant, vibrant anime character roleplay, and a deep narrative world simulator with factions and state variables.

key_features.title: Independent Persona Regeneration
key_features.description: Craft detailed 14-field character profiles and regenerate individual sections like speech patterns or backstories without altering the rest.

key_features.title: Zero-Telemetry Architecture
key_features.description: Your chats, character definitions, API keys, and memory snapshots never touch an intermediary cloud server.

key_features.title: Cross-Platform Ecosystem
key_features.description: Available natively on Windows 10/11, Arch Linux (native pacman), universal AppImage, deb, rpm, Apple Silicon macOS, and edge-to-edge Android.

arch.label: Arch Linux (Native Pacman)
arch.note: Installs the verified pre-built package directly into your system package database without requiring AUR account or compilation.

arch_appimage.label: Arch / Linux (User-Space Script)
arch_appimage.note: Portable single-binary installation directly into your user path. No root privileges required.

debian.label: Ubuntu / Debian (.deb)
debian.note: Native Debian/Ubuntu package with desktop shortcut and icon registration.

fedora.label: Fedora / RHEL (.rpm)
fedora.note: Direct RPM package install via dnf.

windows.label: Windows 10 / 11 (.exe)
windows.note: Full NSIS installer with frameless frosted glass desktop interface.

macos.label: macOS Apple Silicon (.dmg)
macos.note: Optimized arm64 binary for M1/M2/M3/M4 Apple Silicon Macs.

android.label: Android APK
android.note: Edge-to-edge APK compatible with Android 8.0 through Android 16 (API 36). Requires enabling Unknown Sources for your browser/file manager.

projects.name: Astra
projects.short_description: A local-first AI desktop assistant for Windows and Linux with voice control, intelligent automation, and a risk-gated native permission engine.
projects.full_description: Astra is a local-first, permission-safe desktop AI assistant built on Tauri and Rust. Astra is not a chat box: it understands natural language and executes real work across your operating system through a typed, risk-gated tool system. From system control (audio, brightness, network, theme) to app launching, authorized shell execution, file management with automatic backups, web research, and screen vision analysis, every consequential action is approved by a native permission engine in the shell before execution.
highlights: Three-tier native permission engine (low / moderate / high) protecting system security
Deep OS control: volume, brightness, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, wallpaper, shell, and backups
Push-to-talk voice with Groq Whisper transcription and neural speech synthesis
Dual window: full conversation workspace + compact always-on-top global overlay

key_features.title: Three-Tier Permission Engine
key_features.description: High-risk actions require explicit user approval. Web content can never grant privileges, and AI models cannot bypass native shell gates.

key_features.title: Native OS Control & Tools
key_features.description: Automate routine tasks: launch applications, inspect displays, adjust volume/brightness, capture screens with vision analysis, and run authorized commands.

key_features.title: Voice Interaction Suite
key_features.description: Global shortcut push-to-talk, lightning-fast Groq Whisper transcription, and Edge neural TTS with offline system-voice fallback.

key_features.title: Dual Window Architecture
key_features.description: Work in the full conversation workspace or summon the minimalist floating overlay whenever you need quick answers or actions.

windows.label: Windows 11 Installer (.exe / .msi)
windows.note: Official pre-release bundle for Windows 11. Requires WebView2 runtime.

linux_appimage.label: Linux Universal AppImage
linux_appimage.note: Portable AppImage for Arch Linux, Ubuntu, Fedora, and Debian.

arch.label: Arch Linux (Source / AppImage Script)
arch.note: Builds and configures Astra natively under /opt/astra with desktop entries.

projects.name: AstraOS
projects.tagline: Design-focused Arch Linux with Niri & Noctalia
projects.short_description: A curated, design-driven Arch-based Linux distribution featuring the Niri scrollable tiling compositor and Noctalia v5 desktop shell.
projects.full_description: AstraOS is a curated Arch-based Linux distribution for developers and power users who want a coherent, quiet, and beautiful desktop without assembling it themselves. It pairs the horizontal scrollable tiling model of Niri with the Noctalia v5 shell, shipping with a pinned package archive snapshot, seeded Kitty terminal with Oh My Posh, pre-baked LazyVim editor, Btrfs subvolumes, custom SDDM Astronaut theme, and custom system tools.
highlights: Niri Wayland compositor with infinite horizontal scrollable tiling
Noctalia v5 dynamic shell with widgets, launchers, and system status
Pre-configured development stack: Kitty, Zsh, Oh My Posh, and LazyVim
Production Btrfs layout (@, @home, @snapshots) with UEFI boot

key_features.title: Niri Scrollable Tiling
key_features.description: Windows arrange themselves along an infinite horizontal ribbon. Move across workspaces fluidly with trackpad gestures or keyboard shortcuts.

key_features.title: Noctalia v5 Desktop Shell
key_features.description: Integrated Wayland control center, application launcher (Super+Space), notifications, audio mixer, and system monitors.

key_features.title: Pre-Baked Developer Environment
key_features.description: Kitty GPU terminal with Oh My Posh 1_shell prompt, Neovim with LazyVim pre-installed and pre-cached, and fastfetch.

key_features.title: Robust Btrfs Foundation
key_features.description: Partitioned with dedicated subvolumes for root, home, snapshots, and pacman cache. Pinned Arch Linux Archive snapshot ensures reproducible builds.

system_requirements.cpu: 64-bit x86_64 processor (Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or higher)
system_requirements.storage: 25 GB free disk space (Btrfs root filesystem)
system_requirements.firmware: UEFI firmware only (CSM/Legacy not supported; Secure Boot disabled)
system_requirements.graphics: Intel / AMD open graphics (Mesa); NVIDIA proprietary 580xx series supported

build_iso.label: Build ISO from Source (Arch Linux Host)
build_iso.command: git clone https://github.com/AmanicX/astra-os.git && cd astra-os && sudo ./scripts/build-iso.sh
build_iso.note: Requires archiso, git, base-devel, and 15 GiB free disk space. Produces a bootable astraos-*.iso.

usb_flash.label: Flash to USB Stick
usb_flash.command: sudo dd if=astraos-v1-x86_64.iso of=/dev/sdX bs=4M status=progress conv=fsync
usb_flash.note: Write the bootable image to a USB flash drive. Boot in UEFI mode with Secure Boot disabled.

live_session.label: Live Desktop Credentials
live_session.command: User: astra | Password: astra | Root: passwordless sudo in live session
live_session.note: Boots straight into Niri + Noctalia desktop. Launch installer with Super + Space.
